description: This file declares functions, classes, and type aliases related to exporting and serializing TorchScript modules, ONNX models, and bytecode, including functions for exporting modules, serializing model prototypes, and managing serialization options.

classes.name: ScriptModuleSerializer
classes.description: A class responsible for serializing TorchScript modules, including writing files, serializing in different formats, and managing source range tags for mobile deployment.

methods.name: export_onnx
methods.description: Exports a Torch JIT graph to ONNX format, returning a tuple with the model proto, export map, symbol map, a boolean, and node name map.

methods.name: serialize_model_proto_to_string
methods.description: Serializes an ONNX ModelProto to a string.

methods.name: check_onnx_proto
methods.description: Checks the validity of an ONNX proto string.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a TorchScript module into a specified format, writing to a stream.

methods.name: serialize_unified_format
methods.description: Serializes a TorchScript module in a unified format for mobile deployment.

methods.name: writeFiles
methods.description: Writes serialized files for a module into a directory.

methods.name: pretty_print_onnx
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of an ONNX graph.

methods.name: ExportModule
methods.description: Exports a TorchScript module to a file, stream, or writer function with optional extra files and debug info.

methods.name: writeArchiveAndTensors
methods.description: Writes a pickle archive and referenced tensors to an output stream.

methods.name: SetExportModuleExtraFilesHook
methods.description: Sets a hook to generate extra files with metadata during module serialization.

methods.name: export_opnames
methods.description: Exports the list of operator names used in a module.

methods.name: is_default_value_for_unspecified_arg_enabled
methods.description: Checks if default value for unspecified args is enabled in bytecode emission.

methods.name: set_default_value_for_unspecified_arg_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables default value emission for unspecified args.

methods.name: is_default_args_before_out_args_enabled
methods.description: Checks if default args are serialized before out args.

methods.name: set_default_args_before_out_args_enabled
methods.description: Sets whether default args are serialized before out args.

methods.name: is_emit_promoted_ops_enabled
methods.description: Checks if promoted ops emission is enabled.

methods.name: set_default_emit_promoted_ops_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables emission of promoted ops.

methods.name: to_tuple
methods.description: Converts a vector of IValues to a tuple IValue.

methods.name: Table
methods.description: Creates a table IValue from entries.

methods.name: enableMobileInterfaceCallExport
methods.description: Enables mobile interface call export.

methods.name: getMobileInterfaceCallExport
methods.description: Checks if mobile interface call export is enabled.

methods.name: getOptionsFromGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves global compilation options.

methods.name: save_jit_module
methods.description: Saves a TorchScript module to a file.

methods.name: save_jit_module_to_bytes
methods.description: Serializes a module to bytes.

methods.name: save_jit_module_to_write_func
methods.description: Serializes a module and writes it using a custom writer function.
